state:
**Goal `ext-image`: Stages 2 to 5 are done on disk, and Stage 6 (the feature proofs) is in progress.** ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* settle the design, and no session re-decides it.

The component is embedded and callable with no `nvs.toml` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). The `Novis\Image` builder is Novis source in `extensions/image/nvs/`, and `rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`'s fragment says what it has and lacks. Stage 5's figure is in `benches/results/image-guest.json` and `rule:packaging/the-boundary-is-the-cost`.

Stage 6, on disk: `nvs meta --json` lists the built-in classes (`Novis\Image\Image`, `Color` from the source half, public members only; `Novis\Image\Codec` from the manifest, every export `static`) after the registry's in `classes`, and the manifest enums after the registry's in `enums` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/meta.rs` module doc, `builtin_json`). A manifest enum now takes an optional `help` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs`), and every public `Image`/`Color` member has a `///` card, which is its help.

Still red, all Stage 6: the proofs roster's `novis/` paths, and the `Novis\Image` proofs.

items.text: **The roster gives a `Novis\` member the path `novis/<tail>/<member>`**, with `\` in the tail written `-` (`novis/Image-Image/open`), and an enum `types/<tail>` as today (goal file § *Stage 6*, `rule:testing/feature-proofs`). The roster reads `nvs meta --json`, which now lists the `Novis\` classes after the registry's, so until this lands they get `core/` paths. The check's test file `tools/nv/test/roster-novis.test.ts` is new and must print `a Novis class member has its proofs under novis/`. Anchor: `tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts:287`.

**`bun nv reference` reads `docs/reference/novis/`** if it does not already, so `docs/reference/novis/Image.md` (new, in the shape of `docs/reference/core/Path.md`) is shown (goal file § *Stage 6*). Anchor: `tools/nv/cmd/reference.ts:1`.

**The proofs for every `Novis\Image` member**, after the two above, across `docs/examples/novis/`, `tests/hostile/novis/`, `benches/members/novis/` and `about.md`s; `Codec`'s examples and bench are `skip` entries in `data/proofs/policy.json` (goal file § *Stage 6*). `bun nv proofs --id 'Novis\Image\Image::resize'` prints what each owes. Anchors: `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:8`, `extensions/image/nvs/Color.nvs:8`.

backlog: A manifest enum's card has a `short` only; per-case lines (`rule:core-api/reference-card`) need a manifest field for them (`crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs`).
`Novis\Image\Codec` has no class card, because a manifest has no field for one (`crates/nvs-cli/src/meta.rs` `manifest_class_json`).
